title: Missy Higgins, The Teskey Brothers and ICEHOUSE to Headline New Sydney Concert Series
summary: The new Fuzzy-presented series will take over the Fleet Steps at Mrs Macquarie’s Point with a floating stage.
contentText:
Missy Higgins , The Teskey Brothers and ICEHOUSE will help launch The Point, a new Fuzzy-presented concert series at the Fleet Steps at Sydney’s Mrs Macquarie’s Point.

The spring series will take over the harbourside site across September, October and November, with Hot Dub On The Harbour and Harbourlife also part of the lineup. Performances will be staged on the Fleet Steps’ floating stage, placing the run of shows against one of Sydney’s most recognizable outdoor music backdrops.

ICEHOUSE will open the series on Wednesday, Sept. 30, with support from Little Quirks. Higgins follows on Thursday, Oct. 1, for what is billed as her only Sydney show of 2026, while The Teskey Brothers will perform on Friday, Oct. 2, with a 10th anniversary show for their debut album, Half Mile Harvest .

The Point continues in November with Hot Dub On The Harbour on Friday, Nov. 20, before Harbourlife returns to the site on Saturday, Nov. 21.

Fuzzy’s connection to the Fleet Steps dates back more than two decades, with Harbourlife first launching at the location in 2003. For the promoter, The Point also arrives as it approaches its 30-year milestone.

“We have been hosting shows at Fleet Steps since Harbourlife launched here in 2003 and the magic of this location has never worn off,” Fuzzy CEO Adelle Robinson said in a statement. “As Fuzzy approaches 30 years, launching The Point feels like the perfect way to mark that milestone, opening up this extraordinary setting to even more artists and audiences. We cannot wait for Sydney to experience what we have planned.”

For Higgins, the show adds another major date to what has been a busy period for the Australian singer-songwriter, following the continued success of her 2024 album The Second Act , which flew to No. 1 in Australia, and its accompanying national run.

“I’m really excited to be playing with my band at The Point Series in Sydney this October,” Higgins said. “It’s a spectacular setting at Fleet Steps and we’ll be performing on a huge floating stage right on Sydney Harbour. This is our only Sydney show for 2026 and it’s going to be very special.”

The Teskey Brothers’ appearance will mark 10 years since Half Mile Harvest , the Melbourne band’s 2017 debut that helped establish their soul, blues and roots sound with a wider audience.

Tickets for ICEHOUSE, Hot Dub On The Harbour and Harbourlife are on sale now. Tickets for Missy Higgins and The Teskey Brothers go on sale to the general public at 12 p.m. AEST on Thursday, July 16, with a Fuzzy presale beginning at 12 p.m. AEST on Wednesday, July 15.

The Point 2026 dates:
ICEHOUSE with Little Quirks — Wednesday, Sept. 30
Missy Higgins — Thursday, Oct. 1
The Teskey Brothers — Friday, Oct. 2
Hot Dub On The Harbour — Friday, Nov. 20
Harbourlife — Saturday, Nov. 21
